title: Dalilna — Yemen Directory
shortDescription: Find shops, services, places, jobs and buy/sell listings across Yemen.
fullDescription:
Dalilna helps you find shops, services and places across Yemen in one app.

Explore a directory of local businesses and services across Yemen's governorates. Search by name, activity or area, then review available place details, contact options and map links.

What you can do with Dalilna
• Browse shops, services, restaurants, bakeries, pharmacies, schools, public facilities and more.
• Search by governorate and district using the places index and open-map data sources.
• Use nearby search when you choose to grant location permission.
• Explore the buy-and-sell marketplace and submit listings or requests. Submissions are reviewed before publication.
• Browse job opportunities when listings are available.
• Review indicative prices for selected marketplace categories.
• Use the local assistant, or enable the optional cloud assistant after consent.
• Save favourites and selected preferences locally on your device.

Please note
Data coverage and freshness vary by area. A place appearing in the directory does not mean Dalilna has physically verified the business, phone number, prices or opening hours. Confirm details with the business before visiting or buying.

Dalilna does not process marketplace payments in the app. Contact the seller directly and agree on price, payment and delivery before completing a transaction.

You can browse the directory without creating a central account. Some features require an internet connection, and nearby search may require location permission.
